about.title: About AGRO-AI Academy
about.lead: A free learning institution from AGRO-AI Inc., closing the gap between agricultural AI and the people who use it.
about.mission_body: Agriculture deserves the skills to use artificial intelligence with confidence. AGRO-AI Academy teaches growers, agronomists, managers, students, researchers and developers how agricultural AI works, where it helps, and where human judgment must lead.
about.why_body: As we introduced AGRO-AI to agricultural teams in Brazil and across the United States, we saw the same need everywhere: practical education that reaches the people who make decisions in the field, in their language, without cost getting in the way.
about.approach.practical.title: Practical
about.approach.practical.body: lessons start from real agricultural decisions.
about.approach.honest.title: Honest
about.approach.honest.body: we teach the limits of AI as carefully as its strengths.
about.approach.accessible.title: Accessible
about.approach.accessible.body: free, multilingual, and built for low-bandwidth connections and assistive technology.
about.approach.verifiable.title: Verifiable
about.approach.verifiable.body: every credential can be checked publicly, at any time.
about.ecosystem_body: AGRO-AI builds agricultural intelligence software used through its Enterprise Portal and Platform API. The Academy is independent of any subscription: anyone can learn, whether or not they use AGRO-AI products.
about.credentials_body: AGRO-AI Academy certificates confirm that a learner completed a course and passed its final assessment. They are issued by AGRO-AI Academy, a part of AGRO-AI Inc., and are not accredited by a university, government agency or professional certification body.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.free.a: Yes. Every course, assessment and certificate is free. There are no subscriptions, paid upgrades or certificate fees, and we never ask for payment details.
faq.who.a: Farmers and growers, agronomists, farm managers and operators, agricultural students and researchers, and developers building agricultural software. No prior AI experience is needed for beginner courses.
faq.certificates.q: How do I earn a certificate?
faq.certificates.a: Complete the required lessons of a course and pass its final assessment with the stated score (80% unless a course says otherwise). Your certificate is issued automatically once your email address is verified.
faq.linkedin.q: Can I add my certificate to LinkedIn?
faq.linkedin.a: Yes. Your certificate page has an “Add to LinkedIn profile” button that pre-fills the credential name, issuing organization, date, credential ID and verification link. You review and save it on LinkedIn yourself — we never post on your behalf.
faq.languages.a: The Academy interface is available in {languages} languages, the same set as the AGRO-AI platform. Courses are published in English first, and translated versions are labeled so you always know whether a translation has been reviewed.
faq.portal.q: Do I need an AGRO-AI subscription?
faq.portal.a: No. The Academy is open to everyone and is separate from AGRO-AI's commercial products. An Academy account does not create or change any AGRO-AI subscription.
faq.offline.q: What if my internet connection is unreliable?
faq.offline.a: Pages are designed to load quickly on slow networks. If you lose your connection during a lesson, your progress is kept on your device and synchronized when you reconnect. Full offline downloads are not yet available.
faq.verify.q: How can an employer verify my certificate?
faq.verify.a: Every certificate has a unique credential ID and a QR code. Anyone can enter the ID on our Verify page or scan the code to see whether the credential is genuine and currently valid.
faq.accreditation.a: No. AGRO-AI Academy certificates confirm verified course completion and assessment achievement within the Academy. They are not academic degrees or accredited professional licenses.
faq.instructor.a: Courses are written and reviewed by the AGRO-AI team. Some video lessons are presented by an AI-generated avatar; these are always labeled.
faq.data.a: We use your data only to run your learning and credentials. We don't sell it or use advertising trackers. You can download or delete your data at any time from your account settings.
faq.start.q: When do the first courses open?
faq.start.a: The first classes are planned for {date}. Create a free account now and the courses will be ready on your dashboard as soon as they open.
